patch.sql:
select
    distinct
    l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber as order_line_id,
    l_orderkey as order_key,
    l_linenumber as line_number,
    l_partkey as part_key,
    l_suppkey as supplier_key,
    l_quantity as quantity,
    l_extendedprice as extended_price,
    l_discount as discount,
    l_tax as tax,
    l_returnflag as return_flag,
    l_shipdate as ship_date,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as net_revenue
from {{ source('raw', 'lineitem') }}
patch.explanation: The source raw.lineitem contains exact duplicate rows (identical across all columns). The unique check on order_line_id fails because duplicates are forwarded unchanged by the staging model. Adding DISTINCT to the SELECT removes these exact duplicate rows while preserving the original column names and data types, satisfying the unique constraint without altering downstream expectations.
